newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes down on speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes down on speculation.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed down on speculative demand for dollars after the Central Bank boosted the U.S currency aggressively, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.40 to the dollar after opening at 58.35.
"There was no significant commercial demand that could have pushed down the rupee. It was speculators building positions after the Central Bank's action," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by eight local cents, fixing buying and selling prices at 57.5264 and 58.6886.
Overnight call rates remained stable at around 7.5 percent with the market well offered, dealers said.
